pre.name: implement
pre.prompt: Implement every stage of the hardened plan in this worktree. Preserve acceptance-criterion traceability and record the planned evidence results in execution.md. Commit coherent checkpoints. Do not push or open a PR.

loop.name: test
loop.prompt: Run the focused verification commands from the plan, then the repository-required broader verification. If everything passes, emit <|workflow: exit | tests green|>. Otherwise report the failures precisely.

loop.name: fix
loop.prompt: Fix the failures reported by the test phase. Keep the change minimal and coherent with the hardened plan. Do not reduce scope or defer acceptance criteria.

post.name: record
post.prompt: Write the execution summary to execution.md: stages completed, evidence results, commits, and any in-band refinements. Leave the worktree clean.
